# Complete parameters for bases (5, 2)

This file is generated by `export_parameters.py` from the sole parameter source, `parameters.py`. Every table is complete, with no omitted rows. It records choices to be verified, not computation results or a record of successful verification.

This case internally requires a bound strictly greater than `9001/10000`; the paper states the weaker bound strictly greater than `9/10`.

The terminal construction uses the five-step interval recurrence for positive bases. Its `POSITIVE_SETTINGS` are listed in the main supplement; it does not use the `terminal_limit` of the general signed algorithm.
